payload.accepted_scope: Hot lifecycle contracts, short restart and installed CLI replay; 1200s screen is unprepared and not numerically qualified

last_window_inventory.forecast_scope: Conditional constant-rate extrapolation to mass/pressure bounds only; temperature, phase or suction limits may occur earlier; not a guaranteed operating horizon
last_window_inventory.integration_scope: Sampled trapezoidal quadrature; residual includes sampling error and is not a solver balance error

inventory.forecast_scope: Conditional constant-rate extrapolation to mass/pressure bounds only; temperature, phase or suction limits may occur earlier; not a guaranteed operating horizon
inventory.integration_scope: Sampled trapezoidal quadrature; residual includes sampling error and is not a solver balance error

readiness.scope: Whole physical-vector span, not only measured setpoint error; normalization max(abs(end),1 SI unit)

report.scope: Single physical program; even a full hold still needs independent refinement/restart/installed qualification

protocol.scope: Short permissive lifecycle fixture plus strict refusal; not industrial stationary criteria

study_report.accepted_scope: Lifecycle transactions, both restart phases and strict refusal; 0.06s permissive fixture only
